title: Animals
theme: farm and zoo animals, pets, and simple things they do

grammar.focus: sheep/sheep, mouse/mice, child/children, man/men, foot/feet; 'How many cows are there?' with 'There are two'; 'a lot of' vs numbers

title: Jobs & Actions
theme: everyday jobs and the simple things people do at work and at home

grammar.topic: Yes/No questions with do/does and short answers
grammar.focus: Do you sing? Does she work? — Yes, I do / No, she doesn't; the -s goes to 'does', not the verb; 'What do you do?' for jobs

title: Hobbies & Entertainment
theme: going out, music, films, museums and the things people collect and practise

grammar.topic: like / love / hate + -ing, and 'would like to'
grammar.focus: I love singing, she hates waiting; 'would like to + verb' for polite wishes: I'd like to see that film; contrast 'like' (general) vs 'would like' (now)

title: Celebrations
theme: birthdays, weddings, guests, gifts and getting a party ready

grammar.topic: Invitations and suggestions: Let's, Shall we, Why don't we, How about
grammar.focus: Let's + verb, Shall we + verb?, Why don't we + verb?, How about + -ing?; accepting (Sounds good / I'd love to) and refusing politely (I'm afraid I can't)

title: Cooking & Restaurants
theme: cooking at home, ordering out, tastes, portions and paying

grammar.topic: Quantifiers: a little, a few, plenty of, not much, not many
grammar.focus: a little + uncountable (a little salt), a few + countable (a few onions); 'not much / not many'; 'plenty of / lots of' with both; 'How much / How many' — with recipe examples

title: Relationships
theme: friends, couples and flatmates: getting on, falling out and making up

grammar.topic: Question tags: You're coming, aren't you?
grammar.focus: positive statement → negative tag and vice versa; auxiliary matching (do/does/did/will/can/be); 'I'm..., aren't I?'; intonation: falling = checking, rising = real question

title: Work & Leadership
theme: managing people and being managed: delegating, feedback, workload and moving on

grammar.topic: Causatives: have something done, get someone to do, make / let someone do
grammar.focus: have/get + object + past participle (have the report checked); get someone to do vs make someone do vs let someone do; 'have someone do' (AmE); passive-like meaning without saying who

title: Travel & Cultures
theme: travelling properly: itineraries, local customs, living abroad and adapting

grammar.topic: Advanced comparison: the more..., the better; twice as... as; by far; nowhere near
grammar.focus: 'the + comparative, the + comparative' (the further you go, the cheaper it gets); multipliers 'twice / three times as ... as'; intensifying superlatives 'by far the', 'easily the'; softening 'nowhere near as', 'not quite as'

title: Art & Aesthetics
theme: talking about art, music and design with precision: taste, originality and effect

grammar.topic: Gradable vs ungradable adjectives and their intensifiers
grammar.focus: very/extremely/rather + gradable (very moving); absolutely/utterly/completely + ungradable (absolutely sublime, ✗ very sublime); 'quite' meaning 'fairly' vs 'completely'; 'pretty', 'somewhat', 'downright' in register

title: Ethics & Argument
theme: blame, responsibility and how people argue: fallacies, conscience and holding others to account

grammar.topic: Advanced conditionals: inverted (Had I known), unless, provided that, but for, otherwise
grammar.focus: Inversion in formal conditionals: Had she known..., Were it to fail..., Should you need...; 'unless' = if not; 'provided / providing that', 'on condition that', 'as long as'; 'but for' + noun; 'otherwise' as a conditional link
